messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager triggered: route=/v1/chat/completions p99 latency 8.2s (threshold 5s) — 03:07 UTC

jamie: seeing this spike across two models, starts ~02:58 UTC, p95 only up to ~1.1s but p99 huge. noisy but customer-facing requests impacted. any recent deploys?

alex huang: no deploys from infra since 02:40. autoscaler kicked but pods stayed healthy. looks correlated with a surge from a particular customer tenant + batch of long-context prompts.

priya singh: digging into per-model breakdown now. running quick query in dashboards.

priya singh: query I ran:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{service="redwood-inference",route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```

priya singh: result: mistral-8x and open-academic-13 are the main contributors to p99 tail. mistral-8x has a bimodal latency pattern, likely tokenization/long-conversation KV cache churn.

jamie: mitigation idea: can we temporarily route mistral-8x traffic to a lower-concurrency pool or fallback model for tail requests? Also consider raising p99 alert threshold for this route during the incident window to avoid successive pagers while we investigate.

sre_lead: prefer not to raise thresholds blindly. instead: 1) short-term mute pagers for the specific alert (route=/v1/chat/completions p99) for 30m, 2) create per-model p99 alerts so noisy models don't trigger route-level pager, 3) add a noise-gate (squelch) so the alert needs sustained violation for 10m.

alex huang: +1. I'll mute the route-level pager now and start creating per-model alerts. /pager mute alert=chat-completions.p99 scope=route duration=30m

ops-bot: command queued: pager mute for chat-completions.p99 (30m) by alex huang — reason: incident live mitigation

incident-bot: Pager muted for 30m by alex huang — follow up in thread required.

priya singh: proposed new alert rules (draft):```yaml
- alert: chat_completions_p99_per_model
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{service="redwood-inference",route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model)) > 5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: high
    scope: per_model
  annotations:
    runbook: https://console.redwood/internal/playbooks/chat-p99-per-model
- alert: chat_completions_p95_route_agg
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{service="redwood-inference",route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (route)) > 1.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: medium
    scope: route_agg
```

jamie: good. per-model alerts will cut down noise. also add a label to ignore internal/test tenants so they don't skew signals.

priya singh: added tenant != "internal-test" to the queries; new dashboard panels updated for per-model p95/p99. saving a permalink now.

priya singh: dashboard permalink: https://grafana.redwood/company/d/abcd123/chat-completions-tail-analysis (share with oncall)

sre_lead: operational checklist for post-incident: 1) keep the route-level mute until patterns stable, 2) roll out per-model p99 alerts (10m for burn-in), 3) update alert description with sample mitigation steps (fallback model, reduce concurrency, escalate to model-oncall), 4) add a comparison panel pre/post quantization and per-tenant heatmap.

alex huang: live mitigation: routing ~10% of mistral-8x traffic to fallback model (redwood/gpt-compat-lite) via routing policy for 20m to measure impact. /routing set policy route=/v1/chat/completions model=mistral-8x fallback=redwood/gpt-compat-lite pct=10 duration=20m

ops-bot: routing change applied: 10% -> redwood/gpt-compat-lite for mistral-8x for 20m.

jamie: early signal: tail dropped to ~4.4s in the 5m window after routing change. still monitoring.

priya singh: capturing customers impacted: tenant list from logs shows 3 customers with >50 slow requests: tenant-chi, tenant-beta, tenant-edge. notifying account teams.

jamie: handoff: I'm going offline at 03:20 UTC — alex can take primary, priya is backup. leaving checklist in thread.

alex huang: taking over. I'll watch p99 per-model and route-agg panels and adjust the mute if needed. planning to push per-model alerts to staging and then prod after 10m smoke test.

sre_lead: post-incident follow-ups (action items):
- (priya) finalize per-model alert queries and create PR in ops/alerts repo. include tenant filter and a 10m for: window. due EOD.
- (alex) add a squelch config for chat-completions.p99 so noise gating uses dynamic threshold (baseline + delta) and test in staging. due tomorrow morning.
- (jamie) update incident runbook with a new section: "p99 tail: model-specific mitigation" and example routing snippet. due in 2 days.
- (sre_team) update pager oncall-runbook to prefer per-model pages before route-level.

priya singh: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/ops/alerts/pulls/512 — includes per-model rules and dashboards. request review from @sre_lead.

alex huang: staging smoke test passed for per-model alerts (no pings). will roll to prod in 10m.

incident-bot: Note: pager unmute scheduled at 03:37 UTC unless extended by oncall.

jamie: thanks all — leaving final notes: recommend a follow-up postmortem if we see repeat within 72h, and to discuss if quantization/kv-cache improvements would help. :thumbsup:

sre_lead: agreed. closing thread for now, retain logs and dashboard snapshot for post-incident analysis.
